messages:
Claire (customer): Hey — trying to apply promo code WELCOME-50 at checkout and it keeps saying 'invalid/expired'. Dashboard shows the code as active for our org. Order id: ord_01G7X, session: sess_64f2. Email: claire+old@example.com. Can someone help?

Aisha (support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact API response body you see or screenshot? Also which flow are you using (checkout API vs dashboard apply)?

Claire (customer): Using checkout API (js flow). Response: {
  "error": "promo_invalid_or_expired",
  "status": 410,
  "promo": "WELCOME-50"
}
Tried applying in dashboard too — it shows as active under the promo page but when I click apply it errors.

Aisha (support): Thanks — can you share the account/org id you see in the dashboard (org id or customer id)? Also did your org recently do a migration/merge?

Claire (customer): We did a tenant migration last week. Legacy customer id: cust_77-legacy. New org id shown in dashboard: org_9987.

Aisha (support): OK I'm escalating to billing to check promo scope. @Tom FYI — customer reports promo active in dashboard but checkout API returns 410 for WELCOME-50 after tenant migration. Legacy id: cust_77-legacy, new org: org_9987.

Tom (billing): Looking now. I can see the promo row shows scope: org_9987 (active until 2026-08-01). However claim logs show requests using tenant lookup that returned org=org_77 (legacy) for Claire's account — that doesn't match. I'm seeing error in claim-service: "scope_mismatch" -> claim refused.

Tom (billing): Repro from my side (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/claim \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \
  -d '{"code":"WELCOME-50","account_id":"cust_77-legacy","order_id":"ord_TEST"}'
```
response:
```
{ "error": "scope_mismatch", "status": 410, "detail": "promo not valid for resolved org: org_77" }
```

Jordan (devx): This smells like the migration alias mapping didn't propagate into the claim-service's tenant resolver cache. For recently-migrated accounts we resolve organization by legacy_customer_id -> tenant_alias lookup; if tenant_alias empty, we fall back to legacy org which can still be used by older promos. The promo is scoped to the new org (org_9987) so requests resolved to org_77 will be rejected.

Jordan (devx): Quick workaround: support can run a manual credit for the amount of the promo or patch the tenant_alias on the customer's profile so future calls resolve to org_9987. Longer term I'll add a fallback in claim-service to check alias mapping in the DB when cache misses occur.

Aisha (support): Tom — can you confirm whether we can safely set tenant_alias for cust_77-legacy without side effects? If not, please do manual credit and we'll advise customer.

Tom (billing): I can set tenant_alias = org_9987 on the legacy profile; low risk for this org. I'll do that and re-run claim. If that isn't allowed, I'll issue a manual credit and log the transaction. Creating internal ticket now.

BillingBot: Ticket created -> RED-PCS-3456: 'promo-claim-fails-for-migrated-account - tenant_alias propagation'. Assignee: @Jordan.

Tom (billing): Done — tenant_alias set for cust_77-legacy -> org_9987. Re-running claim with their session id (sess_64f2) now.

Tom (billing): Repro result: claim now returns 200 and promo applied. I also created a manual credit of $50 as fallback (txn: tx_5567) while we verify.

Aisha (support): Claire — I updated your account mapping and applied the credit. Can you try checkout again (might need new session)? If it still fails DM me the new session id.

Claire (customer): Retried — checkout went through and promo applied. Thank you! :thumbsup:

Aisha (support): Great — leaving the Jira ticket for dev to add a cache fallback and a migration verification job. Jordan, ping me when there's a rollout so I can close the support side.

Jordan (devx): Will do. Root cause: tenant_alias propagation gap post-migration -> claim-service cached old org. Fix: check DB on cache miss + backfill job. Opening PR with tests.

Aisha (support): Closing loop — customer resolved, manual credit issued as safety, dev ticket open (RED-PCS-3456). If anyone sees similar threads, please reference this ticket.

Claire (customer): Really appreciate the quick help — saved the sale!
_note: No title field included per agents.md. Messages are a single continuous string with sender prefixes.
